title: Upper Social
tagline: Where Social meets Finance.  1️⃣ Invest: Buy fragments in your fave creators' success. 📈 2️⃣ Support: Fund their innovative ideas and proposals.💡3️⃣ Earn: Share the rewards from their content's success. 💰  It's a win-win for creators and supporters alike! 💪🚀 Upper.social
description:
❌ Problem:

Many creators globally face challenges in accessing credit or monetizing their content due to limited access to the banking system. 

We are creating Upper.social to bring revenue to the creators and the inaugural social protocol, Lens.

✅ Solution:

🌟 Curious about how Upper works? 🤔  Let's break it down:

Upper is a social network with a twist; you can become a creator and sell your fragments to your fans and other creators. Fragment holders can trade creators' fragments and vote for proposals, allowing creators to borrow from the fragments pool and create more content.

In the future, content will be sold to repay the debt and share the gains between the creator, the protocol, and the fans who own fragments.

🥳 Fans will be able to: \
1️⃣ Trade: Buy and sell fragments. \
2️⃣  Chat with the Creator: We allow fragment holders to directly access a chat with the creator. \
3️⃣ Vote: You can vote on the creator's proposals to allow them to borrow money to create.\
4️⃣ Create Proposals: They will be able to create proposals, too, for the creator. \
5️⃣Access Premium Content: You can access different creator videos depending on the number of fragments you hold.\
6️⃣ Community Chat: We will allow fragment holders to access different chat groups depending on their holdings. \
7️⃣ Earn: Share the rewards from creators' content's success. We will build a marketplace to upload videos, photos, music, and texts so they can bought and the revenue shared. \


👨‍🎤Creators will able to: \
1️⃣ Trade: Buy and sell fragments. \
2️⃣ Vote: You can vote on the creator's proposals to allow them to borrow money to create. \
3️⃣ Chat with specific fans: Chat with every fan that holds fragments. \
4️⃣ Create Proposals: They can create a proposal and ask for a specific amount from the fragments pool. \
5️⃣ Vote: You can vote on the creator's proposals to allow them to borrow money to create. \
6️⃣ Borrow and Replay. They can borrow and repay a specific amount if a proposal is approved. \
7️⃣ Upload different content: They can sell their content on the platform. \
8️⃣Premium Content: Created content that can be accessed only with a specific fragment amount. \
9️⃣ Community Chat: Different channels to talk with their fans. \
🔟 Earn: Share the rewards of their content's success. We will build a marketplace to upload videos, photos, music, and texts so they can bought and the revenue shared. \ 

It's a win-win for creators and supporters alike! 💪🚀
